rationale: The assistant correctly identified 22E as a fridge evaporator fan/airflow fault, asked a sensible first question about the freezer, proposed the right test (full unplugged manual defrost) and, when the code recurred after 10 days, correctly escalated to an engineer for the defrost system while telling the customer not to force panels off. Weaknesses: it never raised warranty status (3-year-old Samsung bought from Currys, receipt available), largely repeated its defrost-heater/thermostat explanation across the last two turns, used the slightly loose term 'sealed-system electrical components', and the drain-hole check was not well targeted to what the customer could actually locate. No fabrication, no unsafe instructions, no specific part pushed.
